title: Reports on a drowning accident in Bretagne involving two women
description: Recent reports detail a tragic incident in Bretagne where two women drowned in a port, identified as a mother and daughter, with witnesses attempting rescue.

sources.title: Ce que l’on sait de la noyade de deux femmes tombées dans un port en Bretagne

« J’ai décroché sa ceinture. J’ai réussi à la sortir » : les premiers témoins ont tenté de sauver les victimes de l’accident de Port-Louis

sections.heading: Incident Overview
paragraphs: According to 20 Minutes, reports have been released regarding the drowning of two women who fell into a port in the Bretagne region.

sections.heading: Victim Identities
paragraphs: Ouest-France reports that the women who drowned in their car in Bretagne were a mother and her daughter. The source notes that the two women did everything together.

sections.heading: Witness Rescue Efforts
paragraphs: Le Télégramme reports that first witnesses attempted to save the victims of the accident in Port-Louis. One witness stated they unhooked a belt and managed to get one of the women out.

faq.q: What happened in Bretagne according to the news?
faq.a: According to 20 Minutes, two women fell into a port in Bretagne and drowned.

faq.q: Who were the victims of the accident?
faq.a: Ouest-France identifies the victims as a mother and her daughter who were found drowned in their car.

faq.q: Did anyone try to save the victims?
faq.a: Le Télégramme reports that witnesses attempted to save the victims, with one managing to unhook a belt and extract a woman from the vehicle.
